tools.description: Annual consumer price inflation (HICP, all items) for one European country or the EU / euro area, month by month: the % change in prices against the same month a year earlier. Answers "what is inflation in Germany right now" for travellers, investors, journalists and analysts. Source: Eurostat datas

tools.name: eu_gdp_growth
tools.description: Real GDP growth, quarter by quarter (seasonally and calendar adjusted), for one European country or the EU / euro area: change on the previous quarter by default, or on the same quarter a year earlier. Answers "is the German economy growing" or "is Italy in recession". Source: Eurostat dataset namq_
